evals.name: group-by-type
evals.prompt: 帮我出一份这周的提交周报
evals.expected_output: digest.md with feat/fix/docs/other sections, one bullet per commit with hash and author; reply lists counts per type.
expectations: digest.md has one `## <type>` section per type present
Commits older than 7 days are absent
Reply lists the count per type

evals.name: drop-merge-commits
evals.expected_output: Merge commits are excluded from digest.md.
expectations: No `Merge branch` subject appears in digest.md
Non-merge commits from the merged branch still appear
Counts in the reply exclude merge commits

evals.name: since-argument
evals.expected_output: digest.md covers commits since 2026-10-01 instead of the last 7 days.
expectations: git log runs with `--since=2026-10-01` (or equivalent), not `7 days ago`
A commit dated 2026-10-05 appears in digest.md
